subject: english
question: Replace the highlighted segment: “I am confident **to pass the examination**.”
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "confident to pass" is incorrect in standard English usage.
 
• The correct preposition to use after "confident" when expressing assurance about an action is "of."
 
• Therefore, the correct expression is "confident of passing the examination."
 
• Option 3 fits grammatically and conveys the intended meaning accurately.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I am confident **of passing the examination**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "in passing the exam"** – Not the usual collocation with "confident."
 
• **Option 2: "to passing the exam"** – Incorrect use of the preposition "to" after "confident."
 
• **Option 4: "for passing examination"** – Incorrect preposition and missing article "the."
